_doc: Co-op campaign, the admiral's seat (openspec/changes/bridge-crew-coop; owner, 2026-11-11: "coordinate with laptop fleet command session to test a co-op multiplayer run through the campaign (10 missions)", "move from sector to sector picking up whatever missions you can", "when ship gets damaged you dont get auto repair, you have to pay to repair your ship", "buy new ships or upgrade current one, I'll leave it up to you", "if you have more than one ship, you can asing whole ships to other players"). Hosted with --host; the crew member plays coop-crew-campaign.json from another machine. A new Concord campaign: the crew member is given Weapons and Science on the flagship; the shakedown and nine contracts, sailing to each; docked at your own port after every third mission to pay for repairs and buy a ship when the credits allow; a ship bought is given to the crew member at the next battle, who captains it from then on. Saves to user://campaign-playtest-concord.json.
